thread_analysis.thread_summary: Short internal Allion operational thread confirming that SIG payment was received and registration work can proceed the next business day. No external customer-facing Q&A; no new technical cases beyond a timing confirmation. Thread is essentially a handoff note between Allion sales and technical team.
all_questions_found: When can we proceed with registration after SIG confirms payment receipt?
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: SIG's Receipt Number (RN) is issued after payment is confirmed. Once the RN is received, the proxy registrant can complete registration the following business day, assuming all registration content has been prepared in parallel with the payment process.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: Payment → RN receipt → registration submission the next business day. Preparation should run in parallel with the payment processing period to minimize total timeline.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: No significant risk in this thread. Minor risk of timeline extension if registration content preparation is not done in parallel with payment processing.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: None identified. Thread is purely operational.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Parallel preparation of registration content during the payment processing period (typically 2-3 weeks for USD wire transfer) is the standard practice to minimize total project duration.
